value.title: Cheap-model compaction for cold Claude seats (option only)
value.summary: A cold Claude seat that must come back can be compacted on Sonnet 5.5 instead of Opus, at the prime's explicit choice, so the uncached re-read and the summary are paid at Sonnet rates.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: One explicit verb restarts a cold Claude seat on Sonnet 5.5 with --resume --model, compacts it through the normal gates, and leaves it on Sonnet; going back to Opus is a separate explicit revive. Cold, Claude and Sonnet only; never automatic; never /model in a pane. One coder, two review rounds (C34).

sections.name: goals
value: A cold Claude seat that must come back can be compacted on Sonnet 5.5 instead of Opus, at the prime's explicit choice, so the uncached re-read and the summary are paid at Sonnet rates.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Automatic use (no watchdog, sweep or threshold).
A quality study of Sonnet summaries.

value.claim: One explicit verb compacts a cold Claude seat on Sonnet 5.5: `pij-rs revive <seat> --cheap` restarts it with `--resume --model claude-sonnet-5-5`, waits until it registers, and sends the normal compact control through the existing gates. Amended (plan 225b, Jordan 2026-11-10): 5 s after that compaction STARTS, the daemon switches the seat back in-session to its remembered original model, its recorded model (boundModel) before the switch, never assumed to be Opus. It types `/model <original>`, reads the pane once, and confirms the "Switch model?" dialog only if it shows. In-session /model rewrites the user default "model" in settings.json (measured on Claude Code 2.1.321), so each Claude home value is saved first and put back straight after, after the Sonnet relaunch too. boundModel is updated at both switches, only to what is seen: when every home's default already was the original model, settings cannot show the switch back, so it is reported unconfirmed and boundModel becomes unknown, never Sonnet.

Claude only, Sonnet only. A non-Claude seat refuses --ask and --cheap in one line (Copilot bills per request, so the benefit is unproven). Amended (plan 225b): a warm seat refuses --ask and --cheap in one line, because it revives on its own model with no choice; an unknown cache state counts as cold. The model is Sonnet 5.5, never Haiku (its 200k window cannot hold these seats).

Never automatic. Amended (plan 225b, Jordan 2026-11-10): a Claude seat whose cache is known warm revives on its recorded model with no choice. A cold one, or one whose cache state is unknown (counted as cold), refuses `pij-rs revive <seat>` in one line with three runnable commands: --plain (its recorded model, the full context re-read uncached), --ask (Sonnet 5.5, and it stays there: the prompt cache is per model, so going back is an explicit `revive --model <id>` or a compact) and --cheap. A human chooses; the PA and prime offer the three and never choose. No watchdog, sweep or threshold runs any of them. Non-Claude seats revive as before.

Docs: the PA brief, skills/pij/references/routes/community.md and skills/pij/references/routes/peer.md say that for a cold Claude seat the PA and prime offer the three choices (--plain, --ask, --cheap) to the human and never make them, and what each does.

Cost (AGENTS.md, resource cost is a correctness property). No loop, timer or poll. One seat restart per explicit use. --cheap adds, once per use: one live event subscription until its compact starts, one 5 s wait, one typed /model, one pane read, at most one Enter, one settings read and write per Claude home, one registry write and one audit event. No new launch site: the Enter goes through the tmux adapter run(), counted as tmux.send-keys, so crates/testkit/tests/spawn_sites.rs stays green.

Docs and states. PA brief and skills/pij/references/routes/community.md: one entry each (when, whose call, how to go back). docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents new verbs and refusals; the skill's verb coverage tables carry them; `just ddocs-check` and `ddocs validate` on the project docs pass; the PR body has a `Delivers:` line.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Jordan approved on 2026-11-09: 'yes have it built, only for cold seats and its an option'. Earlier rules, 2026-10-01 (Unasphere prime session): 'for seats that are old and uncache that we want to revivie to ask questions or compact we can consuer sonner 5.5'; 'lets leave first class switching out for now'; back to Opus 'only if it then takes on hard work'. Analysis: ~/games/unasphere/scratch/usage-blowout/cold-seat-model-switch.md, section 4 thresholds (300k+ pays) and section 5 (Jordan's pattern): switching every cold seat would have lost money because most went back to Opus within the hour, so option only. Plan 161's POC branch plan-161-model-switch-poc has the per-harness restart-with-model method. Traps from last time: never type /model into a pane (it rewrites the global default; pa.md already says so); update boundModel after the switch or pij list lies.

value.risk: Two lanes edit the same CLI wiring or skill files.
value.mitigation: Rebase onto main before the PR; small diffs at the seam; pm-001 orders merges.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
